summary: Friday's holiday-shortened session saw the dollar hold near a 14-day high with real yields firm, keeping gold pinned despite its oversold bounce attempt. Volatility stayed stuck above its seasonal average, pushing capital into staples and bonds while growth and crypto absorbed the selling, with bitcoin extending its slide below its 200-day average.
tweet: Dollar strength and stuck-high volatility pinned gold and pressured crypto on Black Friday's thin session, while capital rotated into staples and bonds over growth.
